r9_mathematical_correction.terminology_classification: Fixed-Point Correction Measure: cand_raw_delta_d is the unrelaxed PDAS step infinity-norm ||d_PDAS - d^(k)||_inf. It serves as an invariant measure of algorithmic step size across variable under-relaxation schemes, distinguished from the full coupled nonlinear mechanical/phase residual.
r9_mathematical_correction.intrinsic_unrelaxed_norm: cand_raw_delta_d = max(abs(new_damage_pdas[n] - damage[n]) for n in new_damage_pdas)
r9_mathematical_correction.applied_relaxed_increment: cand_delta_d = max(abs(cand_damage[n] - damage[n]) for n in cand_damage)
r9_mathematical_correction.reversion_mechanism: On genuine growth or divergence of the unrelaxed step norm, reverts candidate step to conservative relaxation (omega_d = 0.50), restores stage = 1, and resets stability counters.
